subject: Operations
title: Aligning Operations and Market
description: A quick, practical guide to Aligning Operations and Market.

hook.text: A luxury brand outsources to the cheapest factory. Quality drops. Customers leave. The strategy and operations clashed.

buildup.text: Strategic alignment means operations capabilities match what the target market values most.

discovery.text: A cost-leader needs efficient, standardized operations. A differentiator needs flexible, quality-focused ones.

twist.text: Misalignment is common—companies say they compete on quality but invest only in cost reduction.

climax.text: IKEA aligns perfectly: flat-pack design, self-service stores, and global sourcing all serve the low-cost strategy.

punchline.text: Say what you compete on. Then build operations to match.
